**The Thinker (Le Penseur)** – Auguste Rodin (1880–1882)

Rodin’s bronze “The Thinker” is widely regarded as the most iconic sculpture of the 19th century. Created in the early 1880s, it captured the era’s fascination with modernism, psychological depth, and the power of the human form. Its dramatic pose, expressive musculature, and philosophical title made it an instant classic, and it has since become a global symbol of contemplation and artistic genius.
